# `Q-2-25` — Unclosed Image

> An image construct opens with `![` but the closing `](url)`
> does not appear before the end of the block.

## What this means

Markdown images take the form `![alt text](url)`. This error
fires when an `![` opens an image construct but the parser
reaches the end of the block before finding the closing `]` and
its associated `(url)`.

## Why this happens

- **A deleted close**: the closing `]` or the `(url)` portion was
  removed by an edit.
- **A literal `![`** that was not meant to start an image.

## How to fix

Complete the image with `](url)`, or escape the opening bracket:

```markdown
\![not an image]
```

## Example

```markdown
![
```

- [`Q-2-1`](Q-2-1.qmd) — unclosed span: the same shape for
